name: JL_BR_SPED_EXTR_PARAMS
description: This table contains information about the set of parameters used for SPED extraction.

columns.name: SPED_EXTR_PARAMS_ID
columns.description: SPED reporting parameters identifier.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier for which the SPED text file is generated.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier for which the SPED text file is generated.

columns.name: LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Legal reporting unit identifier for which the SPED text file is generated.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the period for which accounting is done.

columns.name: BOOKKEEPING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of bookkeeping to be maintained. Valid values are: a complete daily book without auxiliary bookkeeping, daily book with auxiliary and summarized bookkeeping, and daily book and balances with auxiliary and summarized bookkeeping.

columns.name: REPORTING_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Level code at which SPED reporting is done, that is Centralized or Decentralized.

columns.name: REF_COA_ID
columns.description: Identification code of the referential chart of accounts.

columns.name: DATA_EXISTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether data is present in the SPED extract table. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: REPORT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the mode in which the SPED text file is generated.
